hook: AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay when you needed a one-liner. Again.
caption:
AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay when you needed a one-liner. Again.

Here's what's actually happening:

AI defaults to "impressive-looking" output. Long. Thorough. Structured. Because that's what most people rewarded it for during training.

But you're not most people.

Some of you think in bullet points. Some of you want the answer first, context never. Some of you need it blunt — no hedge words, no "it's worth noting that," no "in conclusion."

The AI doesn't know that about you. So it plays it safe. And "safe" feels like talking to someone who read a textbook about you instead of actually meeting you.

The fix isn't reprompting the same thing louder.

It's giving AI a profile of how YOUR brain works — how you process information, what format actually lands for you, what tone makes you want to close the tab.

That's what BootFile does. One profile. Works across every AI tool you already use.

Stop training AI from scratch every single conversation.
